scope: Expected acceptance contracts; all execution pending

contracts.add_apply: Only an eligible module/block in a new owned sacrificial draft. Acknowledged identity and defaults are present; no catalog seeding or user-draft mutation.
contracts.edit: Change only intended presentation fields through declared controls; canonical product facts/price/stock stay in catalogue authority.
contracts.reorder: Stable instance IDs and settings preserved, declared order changes durably and renderer/keyboard order agrees.
contracts.hide_show: Visibility state persists through full reload/publish and public DOM exposure follows intended state without losing configuration.
contracts.save_full_reload: Wait for actual normal parent Save acknowledgement/revision; full route reload reconstructs exact intended values/resources; retain conflict/error drafts.
contracts.preview: Current signed/owned preview, correct template/resource and exact section/block selection; measured content dimensions; no forged/stale-message acceptance or saved-draft loss.
contracts.publish_public_readback: Wait for publish acknowledgement and bind exact release/config/public bytes; draft-only values remain private before publication.
contracts.delete_absence_re_add: Delete only test-owned removable module/block, acknowledge reload/public absence, then re-add and rebind supplied resources; record new/retained IDs honestly and recover supported state.
contracts.undo_redo_recovery: Exercise supported inverse/history under actual current permissions; missing promised control is a gap. Uncertain commits reconcile original intent before retry.
contracts.setting_valid_invalid_clear: Use descriptor-defined type/options/limits. Clear/false/zero/unknown differ. Invalid input is rejected without durable unrelated mutation; do not fabricate invalid native select options.
contracts.resource_recovery: Normal supplied image/product/collection/menu/page resources bind real IDs; deleted/unavailable/denied/empty differ; no seeded demo data or DOM/API injection substitutes for UI.
contracts.platform_guard: Platform/security-owned values and @app extension seams remain protected/dormant. Required guard acceptance does not authorize exposing a control.
contracts.identity: Fresh synthetic canonical buyer via normal signup/verification/signin/consent/callback; preserve independent user sessions; positive own context before negative realm/site/buyer controls.
contracts.commerce: Server owns product/variant/options/price/tax/shipping/discount/inventory/order effects. Normal UI primary checkout, original-intent retry, exact expected effects and preserved stock/order snapshots.
contracts.provider: Actual authorized Razorpay Test Mode buyer purchase and owned HTTPS delivery, canonical stored-order/raw-body verification and exactly-one local effect; mock/COD/native source tests remain separate.
contracts.quality: Measure actual viewport/content/font/image/focus/semantics/text/latency and existing budgets. No requested-frame dimensions, single fast request or scan-only certification.
contracts.evidence_review: Every operation links source/contract/artifact/runtime/actor/input/observedUI-HTTP-DB-provider effects, immutable hashes, controller and independent reviewer. No inferred success or duplicate-suite totals.
